conf.description: z/OS ACF2/Top Secret resource-violations, syslog-raw: parses the ACF2 pipe-delimited unload as two sub-grammars (ACFRPTRV generalized-resource / ACFRPTDS data-set-and-program), discriminated by field count. Top Secret RE/DS records are left unparsed - no byte positions are published for this dataset's Top Secret fields (unlike logon-events), so guessing offsets was rejected per brief.

conf.comment: resource-violations / syslog-raw. ACF2 side: pipe-delimited zSecure/CDP unload, two sub-grammars sharing a 13-token common prefix (record descriptor, DATE, TIME, JNAME, LID, UID, NAME, SOURCE, CPU, LOOKUP-KEY, REC, SERV, DISP, FIN) then diverging - ACFRPTRV adds one REQUESTED RESOURCE token (15 total), ACFRPTDS adds DSN/VOL/PGM/LIB (18 total); discriminated by pipe count, unverified against a real sample. Top Secret RE/DS records (RESOURCE NAME, REQUESTED ACCESS LEVEL) have NO documented byte positions anywhere in this work order (unlike the EARLOUT fields on the other two datasets), so they are deliberately left unparsed rather than guessed - tagged with a gap marker instead. See README.

functions.description: ACFRPTRV branch (generalized resource): common prefix + one trailing REQUESTED RESOURCE token.
ACFRPTDS branch (data set/program): common prefix + trailing DSN/VOL/PGM/LIB.
Merge the two ACF2 sub-grammars' shared columns onto one field name each so the rest of the pipeline doesn't need to branch again.

event.outcome from REC (VIO/LOG/TRACE); event.action normalizes SERV to a shared lowercase vocabulary; event.category picks file for DSN-bearing records, process for program-access, else both (the ACFRPTRV generic-resource case doesn't say which without the unsplit resource class). tss.parse_gap flags Top Secret lines (no '|', so neither ACF2 branch fired) that pass through with no field extraction - byte positions for RESOURCE NAME/REQUESTED ACCESS LEVEL are not published anywhere in this work order. Computed before the rename step below, straight off the raw column names (DSN/PGM/REC/SERV), since rename would otherwise retarget DSN/PGM first.

Batch-rename every straight-copy field. REQUESTED RESOURCE is kept whole in acf2.resource.name - the class/type/name split the recommendation calls for needs a delimiter this work order never specifies (only that it's 'class-type-name'), so splitting it would be guessing at data shape; documented as a gap.
Fallback event time - same LPAR-offset/Julian-date gap as the other two datasets; no CPU/SYSID timezone lookup was supplied.
event.dataset set to the data stream's own dataset component (logs-zos_acf2.resource_events).
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
